This is an asynchronous, online course, so there are no regularly scheduled class lectures. However, there are weekly due dates and a few required interactions. Exams will be given in-person at either the U of U testing centers (SLC, Sandy, St. George) or at approved proctors whom students find and arrange. You will have multi-day windows to take exams. Online, at-home testing is not currently available. There are also 1-hour zoom discussion groups which are graded and held weekly on Mondays and Tuesdays. Multiple time options, including mornings and evenings, and alternative ways to complete this component will be provided.
